actions.name: measure_spectrum

facts.text: The module is a cross-platform driver for the Gigahertz-Optik CSS45/MSC15 spectral sensor and speaks the wire protocol over USB HID or RS232/RS485
A Measurement holds the wavelengths in nm, the spectrum in W m^-2 nm^-1 per vendor calibration, the integration time in s, the CCT in K, the photopic integral and PAR
measure() is the automatic integration time measurement (wire G07200, Ihi, G17) and returns a Measurement
get_cct reads G22 in K, get_photopic reads G2R and get_par reads G2L
get_temperature returns the PCB temperature in deg C; the unit is unverified
get_wl_borders returns the first and last wavelength of the per-pixel mapping in nm
get_radiometric_unit reads IhcU and returns W or W/m2
get_last_integration_time reads Ihi in microseconds and returns seconds
get_serial_number returns the USB descriptor serial on the hid transport and an empty string on the serial transport
get_firmware_version sends P and returns the reply string
get_status reads the I0 status word; positive codes are warnings and negative codes raise
The README states the measured spectrum plots as nm vs W m^-2 nm^-1
The README states the wavelength borders of the CSS45 are 360-830 nm, verified on a live CSS45
The README states the GUI shows the photopic integral in lx and the radiometric integral in W/m2
The README states the fixed integration times run from 12 us to 2.56 s
